title: Sharp stars: the 500 rule
summary: The longest shutter before stars turn into lines.

blocks.text: The Earth turns, so stars drift across the frame. Leave the shutter open too long and points become short lines. The 500 rule gives the limit:

items: **High-resolution cameras** show trailing sooner. Use 300 instead of 500 for pin-sharp stars.
Stars near the pole star move least; stars over the equator move most.
Over 30 s needs Bulb mode. If you can't get enough light under the limit, raise ISO or use a wider aperture.
